natural_language_statement:
For a natural number $x$, define

$$
F(x)=2^{\operatorname{log2}(x)}.
$$

For positive x this is the greatest power of two at most x. The natural-number convention has log2(0)=0, hence F(0)=1. This convention keeps the function total; product-bin theorems impose positive dyadic lower bounds.
